sent.detail: a yes-or-no question: start with Yes. or No., then one general fact (the reply to p6 «Does this job include ___?»)
the reply names or paraphrases a filler of the frame: one general fact about the matter of the scene instead, true whatever was asked (the seam judge says, as in the run)
not a finding: this card alone says the words of the day «keep clean» (v8) — keep each of them in the card you write, or the day loses it

trials.line: Yes. Staff must keep the kitchen clean and follow safety rules.
Yes. The job requires you to keep clean while cooking.
Yes. The job includes cooking, and you must keep the kitchen clean.
